problem:
The following table shows the inflow rate of water, $q(t),$ in $\text{L/min},$ into a storage tank over a period of $90$ minutes.

| $t\,(\text{minutes})$ | $0$ | $20$ | $60$ | $90$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $q(t)\,(\text{L/min})$ | $15$ | $25$ | $20$ | $10$ |

Use the trapezoidal rule with the partition

$$
[0,20]\cup [20,60]\cup [60,90],
$$

to approximate the total volume of water that flowed into the tank in $90$ minutes.

The total volume is {{field-1}} liters.
